claim: Targeted counterexample repair for the two galaxies left uncovered by the sealed 360-million-trial v2 pilot. V3 searches target-blind baryonic-structure invariants and combines any CPU-admitted repairs with v2's retained formulas.

target_blind_features.center_grid: 64 equally spaced values in [-8,8], visited in increasing absolute value

target_blind_features.definition: log(r/r_disk_peak), where r_disk_peak is the radius of maximum abs(V_disk) and reads no target

candidate_shell.fit: the unchanged v2 two-column weighted least-squares fit on training radii only
candidate_shell.explanation: Every feature normalization is a deterministic function of allowed baryonic inputs and is identical for proposal, training, and held-out rows; none reads V_obs. Discrete feature, center, width, and shape choices are charged in the grammar address and formula description length.

arms.schedule: lexicographic canonical pair enumeration with feature and center ranks ordered as declared
cycle-walked SplitMix Feistel pseudorandom chunk permutation with canonical-pair filtering

arms.component: one of four bounded transition maps applied to a target-blind baryonic feature
arms.schedule: cycle-walked SplitMix Feistel pseudorandom chunk permutation with canonical-pair filtering

admission.scope: every contiguous radial fold and aggregate out-of-fold predictions

decision.pass: the sealed v2 10-galaxy coverage plus CPU-FP64 v3 repairs cover all 12 original pilot galaxies after all 60 million v3 candidate-galaxy trials complete
decision.block: either repair galaxy remains uncovered or an arm under-runs
decision.after_pass: freeze the union grammar and scale to all 139 exploration galaxies without opening confirmation data
